subject: Vendor tax documentation: W-8BEN-E name/EIN discrepancy - VelaHealth
body:
From: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@velahealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@velahealth.com
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Completed W-8BEN-E for VelaHealth (attached)

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. Attached is our completed W-8BEN-E for VelaHealth along with a brief company info sheet. I uploaded the same PDF to the vendor portal earlier today.

Quick note: the legal name on our bank letter is listed as "Vela Health Services, Inc." while the name on the W-8BEN-E is "VelaHealth LLC" — that was a historical change and our tax counsel says both refer to the same EIN 12-3456789. We can supply a notarized affidavit or a bank letter if you need formal proof.

Attachments: W-8BEN-E_VelaHealth_signed.pdf; company_info_sheet.pdf

—
Ana Ruiz
Accounts Payable Lead
VelaHealth
ana.ruiz@velahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@velahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Completed W-8BEN-E for VelaHealth (attached)

Hi Ana — thanks for sending. Looping in Monica from Finance and Grace from Vendor Ops so we can triage. A couple of items we need to clear before Procurement can issue the PO: 

1) Legal name / EIN mismatch: Our vendor record lists "VelaHealth LLC" (portal ID 78732) but the bank letter you referenced and the company website show variations. For audit we need one of the following evidences that tie the entity name to the EIN you provided (12-3456789):
   - A bank letter on bank letterhead confirming the account name + EIN (scanned, stamped), OR
   - An IRS CP575 or 147C letter confirming the EIN, OR
   - A notarized corporate affidavit signed by an authorized officer that states former/DBA names mapping to the EIN.

2) Signatory authority: If the signer's name on the W-8BEN-E is not listed in our vendor portal as the authorized signer, we need a DocuSign authority form or a corporate resolution showing signer capacity.

3) If you can upload these directly to the vendor portal that speeds things up. Alternatively, attachments via email are OK but we prefer a single PDF bundle.

If you can tell us which of the three evidence options you will provide and an ETA (end of week would be ideal), we can fast-track PO activation.

Thanks — Markus
Director, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Hi Markus — thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide items 1 and 2 this week.

What I'm attaching now:
- W-8BEN-E_VelaHealth_signed.pdf (updated: I corrected the legal name field to "Vela Health Services, Inc." to match bank records)
- bank_letter_evidence.pdf (bank-issued letter referencing account name and EIN, stamped)
- docusign-authority.pdf (signed DocuSign showing Ana Ruiz as authorized AP representative)

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelopes/ABC-123-VELA (redwood should be able to access without a signing invite)

We also uploaded the bundle to the vendor portal under vendor ID 78732 (files > tax_docs).

Please let me know if the bank letter's format is sufficient or if you need an IRS 147C instead.

Best,
Ana

VelaHealth

Subject: RE: Completed W-8BEN-E for VelaHealth (attached)

Markus / Grace — I reviewed the attachments that Ana uploaded to the portal and the email bundle. The bank letter includes the EIN and is stamped by the issuing branch; the DocuSign matches the portal signatory. From a payments perspective this is sufficient evidence to clear the tax gate.

Next steps for Vendor Ops to finish PO issuance: 
- Grace: reconcile vendor legal name in our system to "Vela Health Services, Inc." and ensure portal alias "VelaHealth LLC" is preserved as DBA.
- Procurement: once reconciliation is complete, please flip vendor status to ACTIVE and create the PO (standard net-45).

If we hit any downstream tax reporting issues we can request an IRS 147C, but not necessary today. 

Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
